issue.title: www.theweathernetwork.com

labels.name: T: Incorrect Blocking
labels.description: Website or app not working properly due to filtering

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://www.theweathernetwork.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.theweathernetwork.com%2F) ### Comment > Visiting https://www.theweathernetwork.com/ nearly always results in a pop-up asking to disable AdGuard (about 95% of the time). Force refreshing the page multiple times will sometimes get it to go away, but it's working less and less often. I confirmed the issue occurs with the latest version and rules from AdGuard on multiple computers and Edge, Chrome, and Firefox. This issue has been ongoing for at least a few months. Thank you! ### Screenshots
